_note: Room zones for the IWRL6432BOOST Motion and Presence 2D demo, radar on the short wall at 1.5 m, looking down the room. x is sideways from the radar (metres), y is straight out from it. The demo reads only x and y of a cluster's centre (z is not used in the 2D build, read from mpdproc.c), so a zone is a floor-plan rectangle. Layout is from the antenna evaluation (E178): the radar on a stand at about 1.5 m, a chair at 2 m and at 4 m on the tape line, the door at the far end (a walk-in from behind it was first flagged near 6.5 m). Not surveyed with a tape for this run; the walk-through checks it.
